_comment: Wording changes applied on top of the Figma copy by tools/convert.py (2026-11-07: lead with the MA, skills and work; describe own labels modestly). 'find' replaces text inside a text layer; 'exact' replaces a whole layer whose text is exactly this. 'pages' limits a rule to those page slugs ('*' = every page). The converter warns about any rule that matched nothing.

rules.find: Brands, posters and hand-drawn films, from someone who has founded two brands.
rules.replace: Brands, posters and hand-drawn films, by an MA graphic designer.

rules.find: Working for my dad's brand felt like riding someone else's horse, so I started my own. I predicted the anime tee trend, set up the printing, designed every tee and collaborated with local film teams.
rules.replace: A small apparel label I set up to design my own work. I designed every tee and the brand identity, prepared the print files (DTF, sublimation, screen print) and collaborated with local film teams on fan drops.

rules.find: Started with my dad after COVID, using his knowledge as a herbal acupuncturist to make pickles from exotic plants. I designed the product labels for wholesale and our retail bottles on Amazon.
rules.replace: A small family food label. I designed the product labels for wholesale packs and the retail bottles sold on Amazon.

rules.find: I joined a tiny shop with one employee. With just an iPhone and an old PC, I planned, shot and edited YouTube videos, growing the channel from 0 to 5,000 subscribers. I opened an online store, ran ad campaigns and set up wholesale deals with other herbal brands. When I left, it had grown into a medium-sized business.
rules.replace: I joined a small herbal shop. With just an iPhone and an old PC, I planned, shot and edited YouTube videos (0 to 5,000 subscribers), designed the packaging and labels, and set up the online store.

rules.find: Along the way the shop grew from one employee to a medium-sized business, and our YouTube channel from 0 to 5,000 subscribers.
rules.replace: I also shot and edited the shop's YouTube videos, growing the channel from 0 to 5,000 subscribers.

rules.find: I studied engineering, but I always wanted to be creative, so I started a brand where I could be. I designed film and anime tees, and printed wholesale too.
rules.replace: I studied engineering, but I always wanted to be creative, so Silvercrow became my own design project. I designed film and anime tees and prepared the artwork for printing.
